summary: The Alex Gate Safety Act of 2025 directs the Consumer Product Safety Commission to set mandatory safety standards for certain types of gates, such as automatic and manual vehicular gates and gates over a certain size. It also requires the Commission to run a national education and awareness campaign regarding gate safety hazards and best practices.

affected_groups.effect: Must promulgate safety standards, manage voluntary standard revisions, conduct a national education campaign, and report to Congress.
Must comply with new safety standards and receive educational materials regarding gate safety.
affected_groups.group: Manufacturers, contractors, retailers, and service companies of covered gates

affected_groups.effect: Subject to new safety standards for gates and targeted by public awareness and education campaigns regarding gate safety and maintenance.
affected_groups.group: Consumers, owners, and operators of covered gates

affected_groups.effect: Provided with educational materials to support updating and enforcing building codes for new and existing buildings.
affected_groups.group: Building officials and local educational agencies

key_provisions: Requires the Consumer Product Safety Commission to issue a final consumer product safety standard for covered gates within one year of enactment, incorporating specific ASTM and UL standards.
Establishes a process where future revisions to underlying voluntary safety standards automatically become adopted by the Commission unless the Commission objects within a specific timeframe.
Authorizes the Commission to initiate future rulemakings to modify safety standards to further reduce the risk of injury.
Treats any standard promulgated or adopted under this Act as a consumer product safety rule under the Consumer Product Safety Act.

Requires the Commission to undertake a national education and awareness campaign within two years of enactment to inform the public and industry about gate dangers, safety standards, and best practices.
Mandates the creation of educational materials targeting manufacturers, contractors, retailers, consumers, building officials, and local educational agencies.
Requires the Commission to submit a report to Congress summarizing the actions taken for the education campaign within three years of enactment.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or appropriations authorized to carry out the safety standards and education campaign.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Alex Gate Safety Act of 2025 directs the Consumer Product Safety Commission to set mandatory safety standards for certain types of gates, such as automatic and manual vehicular gates and gates over a certain size. It also requires the Commission to run a national education and awareness campaign regarding gate safety hazards and best practices.
summary_detail.significance: The bill directs federal safety regulation of specific categories of gates by turning established voluntary industry standards into mandatory federal rules and mandates a nationwide educational campaign on gate safety hazards.
